newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline barges flat, cargoes soft.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline barges flat, cargoes soft.

text.p: NWE gasoline cargo prices slackened on Tuesday amid poor demand but barges held their strength better, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded at $199 fob ARA and $200.50 fob Antwerp, compared with offers at $198 fob ARA late on Monday.
But a cargo dealer offering Eurograde barrels said he was now offering at $204 cif NWE, while he had been offering a couple of dollars higher on Monday.
Cargo bids were not heard, and U.S. arbitrage business was not thought workable for the moment.
